bot_strategy_desc: Configure your AI opponent on the frontend
confirm_reset_progress: Are you sure you want to reset all lesson progress?
learn_overview_desc: Step-by-step interactive lessons covering piece movements, tactical maneuvers, special rules, and practice games against AI.
play_against_ai_desc: Put your skills to the test against customizable AI strategy bots.
lesson_not_exist: The requested lesson standard does not exist or has been moved.
lesson_capturing-pieces_desc: Learn how pieces capture enemy pieces by occupying their square.
lesson_capturing-pieces_step_0_desc: Enemy pieces are captured by moving into their square. Take the undefended black pawn on e5 with your Queen from b2.
lesson_capturing-pieces_step_0_hint: Move the Queen on b2 diagonally right to take the pawn on e5.
lesson_capturing-pieces_step_0_success: Target captured! The enemy pawn is removed from the board.
lesson_check-basics_desc: Attack the enemy King and put him in check.
lesson_check-basics_step_0_desc: Check means the King is under direct attack. Move your Rook from d1 to d8 to check the enemy King on e8.
lesson_check-basics_step_0_hint: Move the Rook to d8 to attack the King on e8.
lesson_check-basics_step_0_success: CHECK! The enemy King is attacked and must respond next turn.
lesson_checkmate-basics_desc: Corner the enemy King with no legal escape moves.
lesson_checkmate-basics_step_0_desc: The black King is trapped behind his own pawns. Move your Rook from d1 to d8 to deliver checkmate!
lesson_checkmate-basics_step_0_hint: Slide your Rook all the way down to d8.
lesson_checkmate-basics_step_0_success: CHECKMATE! The King is trapped with no legal moves left. Game Over!
lesson_rook-movement_desc: Learn how the Rook moves in straight horizontal and vertical lines.
lesson_rook-movement_step_0_desc: The Rook moves in straight lines along ranks (rows) and files (columns). Move your Rook from e4 to e8.
lesson_rook-movement_step_0_hint: Drag or click the Rook at e4 and move it straight up to e8.
lesson_rook-movement_step_0_success: Excellent! The Rook moved 4 squares vertically in one turn.
lesson_rook-movement_step_1_desc: Now patrol the rank. Move your Rook from e1 to a1.
lesson_rook-movement_step_1_hint: Move the Rook horizontally to the left corner at a1.
lesson_rook-movement_step_1_success: Great job! Rooks cover long horizontal distances as well.
lesson_bishop-movement_desc: Learn how the Bishop glides along diagonal paths.
lesson_bishop-movement_step_0_desc: Bishops can only move diagonally. Move your light-squared Bishop from d4 to h8.
lesson_bishop-movement_step_0_hint: Move your Bishop along the diagonal to h8.
lesson_bishop-movement_step_0_success: Awesome! A Bishop stays on the same color square throughout the entire game.
lesson_knight-movement_desc: Master the unique L-shaped jump of the Knight.
lesson_knight-movement_step_0_desc: Knights move 2 squares in one direction and 1 square perpendicularly. Move Knight from g1 to f3.
lesson_knight-movement_step_0_hint: Jump your Knight over pawns from g1 to f3.
lesson_knight-movement_step_0_success: Well done! Knights are the only pieces that can jump over other pieces.
lesson_castling_desc: Safeguard your King and activate your Rook in a single move.
lesson_castling_step_0_desc: Castling allows your King to move 2 squares towards a Rook while the Rook hops over. Move your King from e1 to g1.
lesson_castling_step_0_hint: Drag King from e1 to g1 to castle Kingside.
lesson_castling_step_0_success: Kingside castling complete! Your King is tucked into safety.
lesson_en-passant_desc: Special pawn capture rule when an enemy pawn moves two squares.
lesson_en-passant_step_0_desc: Black just moved pawn d7 to d5. You can capture it "in passing" by moving your e5 pawn to d6!
lesson_en-passant_step_0_hint: Move your pawn on e5 diagonally to d6.
lesson_en-passant_step_0_success: En Passant! You captured the pawn as it tried to bypass your guard.
